versions.content: If 'event related data' (extended data or freeze frame data) of an event memory entry is added or updated AND notifications on data changes are configured via DemCallbackEventDataChanged , the Dem shall trigger these con- figured event-specific notifications as well as the general notification GeneralCall- backEventDataChanged .
